name: hbm_quant_e7c2e5b06-tt
purpose: TT-BATCH (owner option B, one large batch): hbm_quant_e7c2e5b06 re-routed at ORFS CORNER=TC (setup repair at TT), flow-hold mm FF hold HM 50, rule H1, CTS fix hooks + consistent die-link budget; original source commit kept; verdict TT setup >= 0 / FF hold >= 0 / DRC 0, SS = sensitivity. | was: hfd_quant FREG=1 (amax re-registered per scale multiplier, kept copies; 0041dfda7 SS +7.49 on f_amax -> u_scale8 k1 / FF -8.59 internal line hold -> loop hold ECO); +1 cycle per quant block | on the r22 budget sheet (pin relays)

bench.name: exact_quant
